mapping.careState: off-chain application state; never authoritative ownership

requiredInvariants: Care must fail closed when canonical SkillPass ownership cannot be verified
Care cannot override or persist an authoritative service-right owner
service consumption must bind to the exact SkillPass authorization stateRef and request hash
a stale stateRef must roll back the Care mutation before commit
provider-specific Care policy is applied only after SkillPass ownership authorization
